briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Shopify, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Changes in the last 30 days (roughly 17 Oct to 17 Nov 2026), based only on the search results provided. Every fact is cited.

## Summary

Shopify reported strong Q3 2026 results and shipped its Fall '26 Edition. A platform security deadline falls before the meeting. The results contain no deals, acquisitions, or executive hires.

## Financials

- Shopify reported Q3 2026 (quarter ended 30 Sep) revenue growth of 32% (32% in constant currency) and a 22% free cash flow margin, announced 3 Nov 2026 (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow).
- The earnings call was held 3 Nov 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET, with a replay in the Investor Relations section (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow).

## Launches

- **Fall '26 Edition (developers):** Opens Shopify's catalog, cart, and checkout to any agent or app, with new tools for building and securing apps and storefronts (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-developer), 28 Oct 2026.
- **Fall '26 Edition (merchants):** Shopify's VP Vanessa Lee says every merchant benefits from every other merchant on the platform (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant), 28 Oct 2026.
- **Platform change with deadline:** The IP allowlist is now required for every public app by 20 Nov 2026, or by 12 Nov if the app uses bulk ops. Token updates were also included (https://shopify.dev/changelog), 5 Nov 2026.

## Hires and headcount

- Shopify's headcount is listed at 30,025, up 5,330 (21.6%) over the year, +1,499 in the last quarter, and +170 in the last month (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/yIg9BumgrtmF). This profile is undated, so treat the figures as approximate.

## Customer evidence

- Dermalogica reported a 9% increase in store conversion, comparing the 30 days after its Sep 2025 Horizon theme launch with the prior 30 days (https://www.shopify.com/enterprise/blog/brands-using-shopify-plus), 24 Oct 2026.
- Staples Canada ran more than four times as many website promotions during Black Friday and Cyber Monday after moving to Shopify Plus (https://www.shopify.com/enterprise/blog/brands-using-shopify-plus), 24 Oct 2026.

## Offers (third-party, unverified)

- A DemandSage page advertises 3 months of Shopify for $1/month, valid until 30 Nov 2026 (https://www.demandsage.com/shopify-free-trial), 6 Nov 2026. This is not a Shopify-issued offer, so confirm it before relying on it.

## Deals

- No deals, partnerships, or acquisitions were found in the results.

## Gaps

- No news from 6 to 17 Nov 2026 was found.
- The results do not cover executive hires or leadership changes.

## Open questions

1. Our apps must meet the IP allowlist requirement by 12 Nov (bulk ops) or 20 Nov (public apps). Will Shopify extend these deadlines or provide migration support for apps that miss them?
2. The Fall '26 Edition opens catalog, cart, and checkout to any agent or app. What controls will merchants and partners have over agent access, and how will data and checkout security be governed?
3. Headcount grew 21.6% year over year, and Q3 revenue rose 32%. Where is the growth being invested, and what does this mean for Plus partner programs and pricing for enterprise accounts?
